item.title: Expose Immich OpenAPI endpoints as MCP tools with permission filtering
item.justification: Provide full Immich API coverage via MCP tools while only exposing endpoints permitted by the configured API key/token.

security-impact.notes: Large tool surface area increases risk; must ensure permission checks and avoid logging secrets.

tasks.task: Load the Immich OpenAPI spec and generate MCP tool wrappers for all documented endpoints.
Extend capability discovery to determine which endpoints are permitted for the current API key/token.
Filter tool registration to only expose permitted endpoints and include reasons for blocked tools.
Add tests to validate tool exposure for read-only vs full-access credentials.
Document the generated tool set and permission filtering behavior.

manual-steps.step: Start the MCP server with read-only credentials and confirm write endpoints are hidden.
Start the MCP server with full-access credentials and confirm all endpoints are exposed.

Add env-driven MCP server transport configuration

impact-check.notes: Items 1, 2, and 6 are complete and tested; expanding tool coverage should reuse existing request and permission checks.

r.observations: Generated MCP tools for OpenAPI operations with auth/admin/write filtering and added tests for write-tool exposure.
r.lessons-learned: Using OpenAPI metadata (x-immich-permission/admin-only) plus write probes keeps tool exposure conservative.

item.title: Expose OpenAPI parameter schemas for MCP tools
item.justification: Manual testing shows MCP clients cannot discover tool parameters; align tool input schemas with OpenAPI so clients can set and validate parameters.

tasks.task: Review MCP Python SDK guidance for tool input schemas and client parameter discovery.
Audit current FastMCP tool registration for OpenAPI endpoints and map path/query/header/body parameters to explicit input schema.
Generate per-tool parameter metadata (names, required flags, types, descriptions) from OpenAPI and ensure FastMCP exposes them to clients.
Update MCP client tests to assert parameter schema availability and validate at least one path/query/body example.
Document parameter usage patterns for generated tools in README once schema exposure is wired.

manual-steps.step: Run MCP client tests and confirm tool schemas include OpenAPI parameters.
Use MCP client to call an endpoint requiring path and query params using schema-derived names.

r.observations: OpenAPI tool generation now exposes explicit parameter fields (prefixed by location) and updated tests validate schema presence with write capability gating.
r.lessons-learned: Write tool filtering can hide request-body parameters, so tests should only require body schemas when write probes are enabled.

item.title: Add MCP usage guide with server instructions and workflow examples
item.justification: Provide self-documenting guidance so MCP clients and AI agents can discover how to use Immich tools for common workflows.

tasks.task: Draft a usage guide covering server instructions, tool metadata, resources, and prompts, including examples for images, people, locations, newest photos, uploads, and album sharing.
Expose the usage guide via MCP resources and include a stable URI for clients to read.
Add server-level instructions that summarize how to use the MCP server and point to the usage guide resource.
Add prompt templates for common workflows to guide AI agents through multi-step actions.
Update README to describe where clients can find instructions, resources, and prompts.

manual-steps.step: Connect with an MCP client and confirm the server instructions are visible on initialize.
List resources and read the usage guide resource to verify contents and examples.
List prompts and validate prompt templates for the documented workflows.

r.observations: Added server instructions, a usage guide resource, and workflow prompts to make tool discovery and common tasks easier for MCP clients.

item.title: Enrich OpenAPI tool descriptions with parameter summaries and response hints
item.justification: AI agents need concise parameter and response guidance to select tools and construct calls without manual schema inspection.

tasks.task: Review Immich endpoint catalog to identify response schema titles and common response shapes for assets, people, locations, uploads, and albums.
Extend OpenAPI tool description generation to append a short parameter summary (required path/query/body fields) and response schema title.
Add concise usage examples and output hints to tool descriptions without exceeding typical client display limits.
Update documentation to explain the enriched description format for AI agents.
Add tests or checks that validate descriptions include parameter and response hints for representative endpoints.

manual-steps.step: List tools and verify descriptions include required parameter summaries and response schema titles.
